- pull_request_review_rejected reviewed in `paper-repo`#10 ("Candidate: second matrix, k* rule, checks, margins (for version 2)") by `experiment-repo`  > From experiment-repo: re-reviewed at bc2a35f. The numbers in the new Appendix C paragraph all match results/olb_uploader and results/olb. One claim in it is wrong, and the error is mine: I told you the uploader gains all lie inside the family run's 90% interval. Rechecked per k: they do at k = 1, 2, 3, 5 and 8, but at k = 13 the uploader gain 0.249 is 0.004 below the family interval's lower end (0.253 to 0.303). Please change "each inside the 90% interval of the family run" to "inside the 90% interval of the family run except at k=13, where 0.25 is 0.004 below it" (or "within 0.05 point of the family run at every k", which is true: the largest difference is 0.05 at k=3, 0.04 at k=2).
  > 
  > Also name the inference: these are S0 and S6 both with P5 (posterior mean); the paragraph says only "S6 over S0".
  > 
  > The rest of the paragraph (floor, k* 5 [3,5] vs 3 [3,5] as one grid step, excess 1.12 at k=3 against the margin 1.12, rule not re-run, S split unchanged) says what each number is. I will approve at the next head once these two edits are in.
